phase_title: Runtime Registry Contract Freeze & Resolution Semantics
summary: Contract/freeze phase only -- no registry implementation, plugin loading, discovery execution, dependency injection framework, or execution capability introduced; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Freezes the canonical Runtime Registry contract before any registry implementation begins: API surface, capability namespace conventions, resolution outcome semantics, plugin selection strategies, compatibility rules, lifecycle interaction model, and failure behavior. Restates, unchanged, the core principle -- Runtime orchestrates, Registry resolves, Plugins implement -- and the full roadmap ordering including Discoverable always. Freezes a nine-operation canonical Registry API (design only): RegisterPlugin(), UnregisterPlugin(), DiscoverCapabilities(), ResolveCapability(), ListPlugins(), GetPluginMetadata(), GetPluginHealth(), ValidateCompatibility(), ListCapabilityProviders(). Freezes eighteen illustrative capability namespaces under a dotted domain.action convention spanning all ten plugin categories. Freezes nine resolution outcomes (Resolved, MultipleCandidates, NoProvider, Incompatible, Disabled, Unavailable, HealthRejected, VersionRejected, PolicyRejected), each with documented meaning and Runtime consequence. Freezes seven future plugin selection strategies (design only, none implemented, none designated default). Freezes five compatibility dimensions (runtime version, plugin version, manifest version, contract version, capability version); future migration policy explicitly named as an open question. Freezes plugin lifecycle interaction as observation-only across six 110B lifecycle states -- the Registry never executes a transition. Restates Registry/Runtime/Plugin responsibilities as contract, verbatim from 110A/110B/110C. Freezes four failure-behavior scenarios, each resolving toward less execution capability, never more. Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_CONTRACT.md, docs/PHASE_110_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to already state the relevant long-term vision (110B) completely -- no change made, matching 110C's own evaluation outcome. 173 new tests, a pure documentation-verification suite. Focused tests (590), governance/autonomy group (1798), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually specified by the validation command (1429/1429, after excluding one nonexistent referenced file and the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
